_doc: MCL39 ride-height sensitivity, flat -25 mm case again: mcl39_rh25 (run 45303302268) diverged in the first-order start (from iteration ~18 a growing pressure oscillation on the rear wing, NaN by 100) while the -50 mm and rake meshes of the same geometry run normally and the mesh quality figures are the same as theirs. The geometry is only translated by the variant, so the bad cell comes from how snappyHexMesh cut this offset: same settings, offset -26 mm instead of -25 mm, which gives a different mesh of the same car.
